description: §21.3 / §41.3.1 — importing `{ totallyBogus }` from the stdlib module `scrml:data`, which does not export it, fires E-IMPORT-004. The module exists, so E-IMPORT-006 does NOT fire — this isolates the name-resolution failure for a `scrml:` import.
rationale: §41.3.1 brings stdlib value imports under §21's import rules: "All other rules from §21 (E-IMPORT-001 through E-IMPORT-004) continue to apply." §21.3: "Importing a name that is not exported by the target file SHALL be a compile error (E-IMPORT-004 …)". Before S462 a `scrml:` import was never checked and the name read `undefined` at run time.
